turnover_financial.text: op draagkracht van derden Wanneer een inschrijver beroep doet op de draagkracht van andere entiteiten en die draagkracht bepalend is voor zijn selectie, vermeldt hij verplicht voor welk gedeelte van de opdracht hij een beroep doet op die draagkracht. Hij deelt tevens de (onvoorwaar delijke) verbintenis mee van die derde of van die derden dat zij hun middelen ter beschikking zullen stellen. De betrokken entiteit mag zich niet in een uitsluitingssituatie bevinden en dient te voldoen aan het selectiecriterium dat betrekking heeft op de draagkracht waarop de inschrijver beroep doet. Indien de inschrijver zich beroept op de economische en financiële draagkracht van een andere entiteit, kan de aanbestedende overheid vragen dat deze laatste zich hoofdelijk verbindt tot uitvoering van de opdracht en vragen het schriftelijk bewijs van een hoofdelijke verbintenis tot uitvoering van de opdracht voor te leggen. Indien de inschrijver zich beroept op de studie-en beroepskwalificaties of de relevante beroepservaring van een andere entiteit, is hij verplicht daadwerkelijk beroep te doen op deze entiteit voor wat betreft de uitvoering van de opdracht. De inzet van and ere onderaannemers is onderworpen aan de voorafgaande toestemming van de aanbestedende overheid. 8.2. Regelmatigheid van de offertes D

The workshops offer structured, hands-on model building activities designed to support patient communication, engagement, insight, and rehabilitation goals. The contractor will deliver four onsite workshops, coordinate planning sessions with PMRS and ERT staff, provide all necessary LEGO materials and facilitation tools, guide participants through the LEGO Serious Play methodology, collect and summarize participant feedback, and conduct follow up discussions with program stakeholders to review outcomes and identify future needs. These services will help expand creative therapeutic options available to Veterans receiving care at the VA San Diego Healthcare System and support whole health, communication, and experiential therapy objectives within the PMRS and ERT programs. deliverables_scope.text: cial Notice DESCRIPTION The Bureau of Reclamation Acquisition Management Division hereby provides notice of its intent to award a single source contract to Rochester Software Associates (RSA) of Rochester, NY. The Bureau of Reclamation intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Rochester Software Associates for professional services to integrate existing internally hosted government perpetual licensed web-to-print application to communicate to outside third-party vendor printing devices. The contractor shall provide all the required integration services and will include additional site license and maintenance support for all requirements issued under the contract. Reclamation utilizes Rochester Software Associates (RSA) WebCRD web-to-print web-based application hosted by the Government on its Intranet to place and submit printing related orders. WebCRD is a web-based print job submission software that allows users to submit printing or reproduction requests via a browser connection. The job status can be tracked by the user. The product provides customizable reports for summarizing device utilization and printing costs. The product also provides for tab creation and the build a job; adding multiple files and arranging them; as well as combining them with markers

ts. The product also provides for tab creation and the build a job; adding multiple files and arranging them; as well as combining them with markers for potential tab placement at the markers. The following current modules implemented with the WebCRD include: Dynamics, Book Assembly, AutoStock. THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES. The determination not to compete this proposed purchase order base and four option years was made pursuant to the Federal Acquisition Regulation, Revolutionary FAR Overhall (RFO) FAR Part 12.102, only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. The Government anticipates award on or around September 17, 2026. A determination not to compete this requirement, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government. The Bureau of Reclamation will not be responsible for any costs incurred by interested parties in responding. Interested parties must submit clear and convincing documentation demonstrating their capability to meet the requirements above, including general background, technical qualifications, and relevant experience, via email to Savanna Manning, Contract Specialist, at savanna_manning@ios.doi.gov.
